## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-6: outbound_update v1 {title,description,assignee,priority}; status routing gated behind DSO_RECONCILER_STATUS_GATING env var; raises StatusMappingError until draft-5

Flesh out _outbound_update(mutation) in applier.py: DirectionMismatchError guard (OUTBOUND). For allowlist {title,description,assignee,priority}: _call_with_retry(client.update_issue, key, field_updates, retry_budget=RETRY_BUDGET). For 'status' field touch: if os.environ.get('DSO_RECONCILER_STATUS_GATING') falsy/unset -> raise StatusMappingError("status routing requires DSO_RECONCILER_STATUS_GATING; field touched but draft-5 routing not yet wired"); if truthy -> call _route_status_via_draft5 stub (raises NotImplementedError). Other fields -> UnknownActionError (do not silently drop).

## Test Approach
Given Mutation(OUTBOUND, UPDATE, payload={title:'X'}) + MagicMock client; When _outbound_update invoked; Then client.update_issue called via _call_with_retry. AND status touch with DSO_RECONCILER_STATUS_GATING unset -> StatusMappingError raised, client.update_issue not called.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py
- [ ] Allowlist fields route via _call_with_retry
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_outbound_update.py -k allowlist_field
- [ ] Status touch + gating off -> StatusMappingError, zero side-effects
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_outbound_update.py::test_status_gating_off_raises_no_side_effects
- [ ] Status touch + gating=1 -> _route_status_via_draft5 stub invoked
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_outbound_update.py::test_status_gating_on_delegates_to_draft5

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py — Edit
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_outbound_update.py — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
